spot_ema.meaning: spotEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at the checkpoint before twapEMA() computes the TWAP

fast_ema.meaning: fastEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at the checkpoint before twapEMA() computes the TWAP

slow_ema.meaning: slowEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at the checkpoint before twapEMA() computes the TWAP

eons_ema.meaning: eonsEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at the checkpoint before twapEMA() computes the TWAP

twap_spot_weight.meaning: weight (in percent) that the computed TWAP places on the short-horizon spotEMA component

assumptions: The TWAP is computed from the OraclePack.getEMAs() return values as described in the report.
Short-horizon movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs, so spotEMA differs from slowEMA in the scenario.
The TWAP feeds PanopticPool.getTWAP() and liquidation solvency checks as stated.

unresolved.description: The report states the intended blend (6*fastEMA + 3*slowEMA + eonsEMA)/10 and the buggy blend (6*slowEMA + 3*fastEMA + spotEMA)/10, but the selected impact v_spot_weight is only the spotEMA weight (10% vs 0%); the full weighted-sum relation cannot be encoded without a division/rate construct, so only the spotEMA weight is formalized.

limitations: Only the spotEMA weight aspect of the TWAP blend is formalized; the eonsEMA contribution and the full weighted-sum formula are not encoded.
No concrete on-chain values or transaction are given; the plan is symbolic.
Downstream StaleOracle and liquidation outcomes are separate impacts handled in other passes.
